reason: Leaked ZZ- fixtures from failed test:rls runs skewed local counts. Cleanup needed three attempts: a dry run hit a varchar-vs-uuid cast error on auth.refresh_tokens, and the agent used an FK-bypass shortcut that is unsafe for append-only tables. The safe sequence (rollback dry run, counted scope, text casts, no replica role) is not captured by eventar-live-verify-worktree, which covers seeding rather than leak removal.

A backtest cleanup found audit_events up 16 against baseline, with 4 rows not traceable to its fixtures because another agent wrote at the same time. Counting deltas alone hides that; attribution by fixture is the rule.
